name: Shipstry
tagline: **Shipstry** is a product launch registry where makers showcase their creations and users discover the next big thing
description: **Shipstry** is a product launch registry where makers showcase their creations and users discover the next big thing. **For Makers:** - Submit your product with rich media, detailed descriptions, and tags - Schedule your launch week for maximum visibility - Gain upvotes and feedback from an engaged community - Compete for weekly and monthly awards (Gold, Silver, Bronze) - Track your product's performance through analytics **For Discoverers:** - Browse products across 10+ categories including AI
